    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "query = \"\"\"\n",
        "SELECT Month,\n",
        "       ROUND(SUM(TotalAmount),2) AS\n",
        "Revenue\n",
        "FROM Amazon\n",
        "GROUP BY Month\n",
        "ORDER BY Month\n",
        "\"\"\"\n",
        "\n",
        "monthly_sales = pd.read_sql(query, conn)\n",
        "\n",
        "monthly_sales"

      "source": [
        "query = \"\"\"\n",
        "SELECT Category,\n",
        "       ROUND(SUM(Profit),2) AS Total_Profit\n",
        "FROM Amazon\n",
        "GROUP BY Category\n",
        "ORDER BY Total_Profit DESC\n",
        "\"\"\"\n",
        "\n",
        "profit_df = pd.read_sql(query, conn)\n",
        "\n",
        "profit_df"
